subject: TerraMark onboarding — aligning PO flow & payment cadence
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@terramark.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood vendor setup — payment terms question

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. We're excited to get TerraMark set up as a Redwood supplier. A quick question from our AP team: what net terms do you accept for new suppliers, and what options exist for early-pay/discount programs? Our standard is Net 45, but we can be flexible for an onboarding period. Also confirm whether Redwood needs a PO for every invoice or if you accept consolidated monthly POs for services.

Can you point me to the onboarding packet and any specific PO field mappings we should complete? AP is asking for the contact who will approve POs and the billing cadence.

Appreciate the help — attaching our profiles if that helps.

Best,
Emma Li
Finance Ops Manager
TerraMark Systems
attachments: TerraMark_Vendor_Profile.pdf (stub)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Emma Li <emma@terramark.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-16T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor setup — payment terms question

Hi Emma — great to hear from you and glad the demo was helpful. Short answers:

- Standard onboarding default is Net 30.
- We can support Net 45 or Net 60 for enterprise customers on request (we record it on the PO and the supplier profile).
- We run a consolidated PO model for monthly services if you provide an invoice reference that maps to a PO number; otherwise we require an invoice per PO for one-off purchases.

We do have an early-pay program (invoice-level opt-in) — typically we offer a 1.5% discount for payment within 10 days, subject to procurement approval and enrollment in our early-pay pilot.

I'll loop in Marissa (procurement) and David (billing) to confirm the PO field mapping and to send the vendor onboarding packet. Can you confirm TerraMark's preferred remit email and if you require our W-9?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Lead, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood vendor setup — payment terms question

Marissa / David — forwarding TerraMark's AP inquiry. Key asks: Net45 preferred, confirm PO model (they'd prefer consolidated monthly) and whether we can offer early-pay at a 1–1.5% rate. TerraMark is in the Pacific region and is a mid-market integration partner; deal id TMK-7843.

Notes/thoughts:
- If we can give Net45 for onboarding (30 after first 60-day billing cycle), that might remove friction.
- Early-pay: what's our current threshold for enrollments (minimum invoice size / vendor age)?
- PO fields: they need a short doc showing required fields for their AP system.

Can you advise next steps and whether procurement needs signature from their legal before enrollment?

— Jonas

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood vendor setup — payment terms question

Thanks for the context. Quick procurement checklist below:

- PO model: We can accept a single consolidated monthly PO for recurring services, provided each invoice references the PO number and item codes. For one-time professional services we still prefer invoice-per-PO.
- Net terms: Procurement will approve Net45 for the first 90 days if TerraMark completes our onboarding form and provides W-9 + bank remit instructions. After the trial period we default to Net30 unless there's an approved exception (deal-specific).
- Early-pay: Our current pilot allows vendors to enroll if they meet either (a) 3 invoices in the last 60 days or (b) minimum invoice size $2,000. Discount band is 1.0%–1.5% depending on volume. Approval requires finance sign-off (David).
- PO field mapping: see attached Redwood_PO_Instructions.docx — includes required fields (PO#, line-item code, start/end service dates, remit email).

Action items for TerraMark:
1) Complete Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf and return with W-9 + remit instructions.
2) Confirm whether you'll enroll in early-pay pilot and if so which invoices to opt into.

Jonas — I'll approve Net45 provisional for onboarding once we receive the docs; David, can you confirm the early-pay discount range?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_PO_Instructions.docx (stub), Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (stub)
From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-20T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood vendor setup — payment terms question

Confirming finance stance:
- We can support the 1.0%–1.5% early-pay discount. Recommendation: offer 1.25% standard for pilot enrollee vendors under $50k monthly and 1.5% for >$50k.
- Enrollment: TerraMark will need to opt each invoice (we won't auto-enroll).
- Cutoff: If they want Net45 for onboarding, we should tag that on the vendor profile as a 90-day exception; operations will revert to Net30 automatically unless extended.

I'll prep the billing note for accounts payable and include the PO mapping doc in the vendor file.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: finance@terramark.com
Date: 2028-04-29T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor setup — payment terms question

Hi Jonas / Marissa / David —

Thanks for the clear guidance. TerraMark will:
1) Complete and return the Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf and attach our W-9 and bank remit details by end of day Friday.
2) Start with Net45 provisional for the 90-day onboarding window.
3) Opt in to the early-pay pilot for qualifying invoices and target the 1.25% discount tier (based on expected volumes).
4) Use a consolidated monthly PO for managed services — we'll ensure every invoice includes the PO# and line-item mapping.

Attached: TerraMark_W9.pdf (stub). Please confirm once your team has created the vendor profile and applied the onboarding Net45 exception.

Best regards,
